creators.lesson: Mix product content with behind-the-scenes so it doesn't feel like ads.

creators.why: Strong month on TikTok for beauty and brand content.

topics.title: Top US searches after the midterms (IBTimes)
Poison center calls about weight-loss drugs (Yahoo)

topics.angle: 'What I actually spend on my GLP-1 routine' honest breakdown. Say clearly that supplements aren't medicine, tag any paid product as an ad, and tell viewers to ask their doctor.
topics.title: GLP-1 supplement boom on TikTok
topics.why: People on Ozempic/Wegovy are buying fiber, collagen and electrolyte supplements after TikTok creators promote them for nausea, fatigue and digestion. The FDA is weighing stricter supplement rules.

topics.angle: Safety-first PSA: why mg, units and mL get confused, and why to get meds from a licensed pharmacy and ask the pharmacist. Never give dosing numbers yourself.
topics.title: GLP-1 dosing mix-ups in the news
topics.why: A Washington poison center reports 665 GLP-1 medication calls so far in 2026, up from 421 last year, mostly from dosing confusion with compounded vials measured at home.

topics.angle: 60-second 'what's new in weight-loss meds this week' explainer. Cite the source on screen and avoid promising results.
topics.title: ObesityWeek 2026: new weight-loss drug data
topics.why: Novo Nordisk is presenting new real-world Wegovy results and CagriSema data at ObesityWeek in early November.

topics.angle: 'Is it better to speak or to die… or to forget leg day again?' Film yourself mid-set with the text overlay.
topics.title: "Is it better to speak or to die": gym version
topics.why: A fill-in-the-blank audio where creators finish the dramatic question with what they'd choose every time. Gym creators use it for workout pain points.

topics.angle: 'Me finding out you still do your whole workout from memory' then cut to your saved routine or tracker.
topics.title: "No that doesn't make any sense": gym edition
topics.why: Lip-sync with a confused face and a text overlay describing something that makes no sense. Fitness creators use it for workout habits.

topics.angle: Film your 'Halloween to Christmas' flip in one cut: pumpkin decor out, tree and lights in, first holiday drink in hand.
topics.sound: Mariah Carey – All I Want for Christmas Is You
topics.title: Mariah "It's Time" holiday switch
topics.why: Halloween is over and creators are flipping to Christmas: trees go up, holiday drinks, cozy mornings. Instagram shows about 5.8M Reels on this audio.

topics.angle: Plain morning to full look, then a quick cut of you working (filming, editing, packing orders). Add one line about showing up for yourself.
topics.title: "Housewife" outfit & work reveal
topics.why: No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100. Creators use it for confident get-ready clips, outfit reveals and clips of them at work.

topics.angle: Bare face, messy bun, then the beat drops into full glam. Pin the products in comments.
topics.title: The Nicole Kidman glow-up
topics.why: No. 6 on the Hot 100 and marked Trending on Instagram. Hard cut from a plain 'before' to a red-carpet hair, makeup and outfit reveal.

topics.angle: Do it with your mom, sister or best friend. The 'me vs. AI version' twist is getting extra shares.
topics.title: Dame Hombro shoulder dance
topics.why: A freestyle shoulder-bounce dance done solo, with friends, work teams, or as 'me vs. AI' comparisons.

topics.angle: Hallway or street 'runway' in your best fall look, nail the hip pop and the turn, end on a slow-mo smile.
topics.title: Angel of My Dreams runway hip pop
topics.why: After the Victoria's Secret show, creators recreate Kylie Jenner's hip pop and hesitant runway turn for outfit reveals and dreamy edits.

topics.angle: 3 fall outfits, one fan wipe each. Build it in TikTok's own editor, no extra app needed.
topics.title: Fan-blade outfit transition
topics.why: Overhead shot where a ceiling-fan wipe hides the outfit change. Popular for fall styling videos.

topics.angle: No wedding? Use it for a friend's wedding, a bridal-guest GRWM, or a 'how we met' story.
topics.title: Patient Zero wedding edits
topics.why: No. 8 on the Hot 100. Couples cut wedding footage into cinematic edits timed to the song's ending.

topics.angle: Photo mode: 'Stop the wedding, but my makeup artist…' then 5 slides of the story. Easy to make, high comment rate.
topics.title: "Stop the wedding, but…" carousels
topics.why: Photo carousels that open with 'Stop the wedding, but…' and then reveal a wedding regret or funny memory.

topics.angle: Ask your mom or your followers' favorite AI: 'Describe my style in one word.' React to each answer.
topics.title: Answer in one word
topics.why: Creators make ChatGPT, friends or family answer personal questions in one word, then screen-record the replies.

topics.angle: Girls' night version: each friend walks in slow-mo with one prop. Great for collabs.
topics.sound: The Weeknd & Kendrick Lamar – Pray For Me
topics.title: Pray For Me slow-mo entrances
topics.why: Friends take turns making over-the-top slow-motion entrances in one steady wide shot.

topics.angle: 'POV: the outbreak starts at Sephora' as a 3-part series. The cliffhanger brings people back for part 2.
topics.title: Zombie outbreak survival stories
topics.why: Animated second-person zombie stories set in familiar places, posted in numbered parts with cliffhangers.

topics.angle: Skip this unless politics is your niche. If you post, use only verified facts and expect heated comments.
topics.title: 2026 midterm election results
topics.why: After Election Day, US searches were led by results for individual races and states. Searches for 'habibi meaning' also spiked after a newly elected senator used the word in a victory speech.

topics.angle: Gaming isn't your niche? A 'gamer girlfriend explains it in 60 seconds' Short can still ride the search spike.
topics.title: Elder Scrolls VI name reveal
topics.why: Bethesda's official name reveal is the top trending YouTube video in the US by virality, with about 1.9M views.

topics.angle: Share your own wishlist as a carousel, or a 'gifts under $30 for your bestie' list with links.
topics.title: Holiday wishlists & Secret Santa
topics.why: Wishlist app GoWish is climbing the US top free chart as people start holiday gift planning.
